name: OsO2 rutile, Boman experimental data via Baur and Khan1971
citation: W. H. Baur and A. A. Khan. Rutile-type compounds. IV. SiO2, GeO2 and a comparison with other rutile-type structures. Acta Crystallographica B27 (1971),2133–2139. DOI10.1107/S0567740871005466. Table4 attributes OsO2 data to C.-E.Boman, Precision Determination of the Crystal Structure of Osmium Dioxide, Acta Chemica Scandinavica24 (1970),123–128, DOI10.3891/acta.chem.scand.24-0123.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Experimental OsO2 structural data attributed to Boman1970 in the original COD record and published Baur/Khan1971 Table4. Exact measurement apparatus was not independently accessible in the original Boman article.
notes: One independent Os site,multiplicity2; complete split six-O rutile shell preserved.

Source is the exact COD/AMCSD OsO2 record, not an elemental substitution into RuO2/IrO2. The provenance chain is Boman1970 experimental refinement, reproduced in Baur/Khan1971 Table4, then AMCSD0009415 and COD9007542.
Published table and original CIF agree on a4.5003A,c3.1839A,and oxygen coordinateu0.3081. Original deposited precision and omitted occupancy are retained.
This reference covers rutile Os(IV)-O, not elemental Os-Os. ElementalOs candidates with theoretical fcc geometry, natural alloy contexts or unresolved old kX calibration were not selected.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Numerical measurement temperature and pressure are absent from the original CIF and verified table. Do not assume300K from later compilations or substitute a synthesis temperature.

occupancy.interpretation: Occupancy column absent; unit occupancy is parser interpretation, not an explicit refined occupancy.
